tasks.title: Climate resilience partnership priorities
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: In your English class you have been discussing how to set priorities for a climate resilience partnership in your region. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: 1. improving flood defences in low-lying areas
2. setting up emergency cooling centres during heatwaves

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

tasks.title: Climate adaptation workshop review
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted!
paragraphs: Have you attended a community workshop on climate adaptation organised by the Climate Resilience Partnership? We want to hear about your experience.
listItems: Describe what the workshop covered and how it was run.
Say how useful it was for understanding local climate risks.
Would you recommend this workshop to other residents? Why or why not?
promptBlocks.footer: The best reviews will be published in the partnership's newsletter.

tasks.title: Making homes more climate-ready
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: The Climate Resilience Partnership wants to help residents make their homes more prepared for extreme weather. What practical steps can people take without spending a lot of money?
listItems: Describe one low-cost measure to protect a home from flooding or heat.
Explain why this measure is effective.
Suggest how the partnership could support residents in adopting it.
promptBlocks.footer: We will publish the best articles on our website.

tasks.title: Volunteering for climate resilience
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.subject: Volunteering for climate resilience
paragraphs: I heard that the Climate Resilience Partnership is looking for volunteers to help with local projects. I'm thinking of joining but I'm not sure what to expect.
Can you tell me what kind of tasks volunteers usually do? Also, what practical difference do you think these projects make in the community? And how much time would I need to commit?
